notes.title: Patch v 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello all! We've received a good helping of feedback from the community since our last patch, so we decided to take some time to address these concerns in our latest update:

[list]
[*]Cyclops fight has been rebalanced. Starting Consciousness has been raised and the rate at which it depletes has been lowered (from every 0.25s to 0.4s). 
[*]All difficulty levels have had their Consciousness depletion amounts lowered
[*]Fixed an issue where the Bronze Armour would increase the timer during the Cyclops fight
[*]Enemies in the 4th and 5th acts have had their health totals rebalanced, as the difficulty spike was quite jarring
[*]Added 50+ missing common Spanish words to the Spanish dictionary
[*]Small UI adjustments
[*]Small bug fixes
[/list]
That's all for now! We're always keeping an eye on what the community is talking about, so don't be afraid to let us know what's on your mind! Have fun!

- The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Time for another patch! Here's your updates:
[list]
    [*]Added Delete Live Act Save Data option in the Level Select options menu
    [*]Damage Potions are 50% weaker
    [*]Combat damage indicator stays on screen for longer when time runs out
[*]Time Bonus Tile coloured changed to help differentiate between it and the Gold Bonus Tile
[*]Rewards for overkill (2x, 3x, etc) damage now shown on level end slate
[*]Fixed some typos
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]
Enjoy!

- The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Back once again more patch notes!
[list]
[*]Reduced Charge required for all weapons by 20%
    [*]Potions will now be refunded on player loss
[*]Changed Hangman per-guess timer to 20 seconds
    [*]Created Rehearsal (Very Easy) difficulty for the Typing Mode
    [*]Re-Balanced Typing Easy difficulty to be between Rehearsal and Medium
 [*]Greatly improved upon the potion cooldown graphic
    [*]Hangman & Chest answers will stay on screen longer so you can see what they were more easily
    [*]Increased volume of sound played when entering letters
    [*]Damage & Time potions enabled and balanced for the Cyclops battle (both potions increase consciousness meter)  
    [*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

And here are some current plans for future patches:
[list]
    [*]Create option to delete Live Act save progress
    [*]Moving letter tiles closer together for increased readability
    [*]Continue to show damage dealt during attack sequence
[*]Show rewards for Overkilling (2x, 3x, etc.) an enemy on level end slate
[/list]

If you have more suggestions for future patch notes, be sure to let us know!

- The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Back again with another Patch. Here's the changes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed issue with some achievements sometimes not updating progress correctly
    [*]Medusa mirror tile is now more easily distinguishable from other tiles
    [*]Key press sound will now play when you enter a correct letter in Typing Mode
[*]Base Hangman guesses increased from 3 to 5
[*]Price of potions has been dramatically decreased from 2500 to 500 gold
[*]Easy Difficulty for Typing has been updated. Scenarios with many enemies on screen at once are now balanced correctly.
[*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for the feedback, keep sending it our way!

Enjoy,
- The Mega Dwarfs

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've taken some of the feedback we've gathered already and have pushed a new patch live. Here are the changes:

[list]
    [*]Hard+ Difficulty added to Combat Difficulty selection (for those word Gods out there)
    [*]Typing & Combat Marathon Leaderboards have been added for each difficulty
    [*]Typing Marathon end slate now has "Next" and "Retry" buttons. Next will change the typing scenario to a new random one, and retry will restart the current scenario
    [*]Various bug fixes
    [*]Legitimate minor text fixes 
[/list]

Be sure to send your feedback our way, we'll be patching as much as we can.

Thanks and have fun,
- The Mega Dwarfs
